ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 MT. ELLIOTT AVENUE DETROIT, (7) MICH. November 30th 1946
God bless you Doris Panyard.
Many thanks again for your favor of Nov. 11th. I am here -- I expect - till next Tuesday; possibly a few days longer. Am trying to reduce my unexamined letters, over fifty.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
God bless you all and each.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
